goal: Add deterministic in-process end-to-end failure-injection coverage for the shared proxy control plane: proxy-auth 407 and transport failure drive health/circuit failure, half-open recovery succeeds with hysteresis, generation rotation invalidates an old AccountRuntime, and a fresh runtime generation is admitted.
context: This is a test-harness batch, not a production behavior redesign. The test MUST actually execute network.HealthReportingTransport.RoundTrip with an in-process scripted RoundTripper that returns HTTP 407, a transport error, and HTTP 200 responses. Feed the emitted HealthResult values through the real proxycontrol.ApplyHealth and proxycontrol.Allow functions using a deterministic clock/policy, and assert CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED including recovery hysteresis. Then use proxycontrol.BumpGeneration and AccountRuntime.CheckMutationGeneration to prove old-runtime rejection and fresh-runtime admission. A fake store may hold current generation only; it MUST NOT return precomputed health/circuit states. Keep the scenario in the existing internal/app/provider_network_runtime_test.go; do not require a new test file and do not modify provider driver tests. No external network, sleeps, schema, or production behavior changes.
commit_message: test(proxy): prove control-plane failure recovery e2e
